title: database "Lungencheck"
summary: This project involves the establishment and operation of a registry database for the systematic collection, storage and scientific use of radiological lung imaging data, associated routine clinical data, histopathological and molecular pathological findings, bronchoscopic investigation results, and longitudinal follow-up data, together with any available biological samples. The samples comprise residual material obtained during routine diagnostic procedures which would otherwise be discarded, including blood, tissue samples and lavage fluids.
conditions: Special screening examination for neoplasm of respiratory organs

interventions.name: Establishment and maintenance of a registry database for the systematic collection, storage and scientific use of radiological lung imaging data, associated routine clinical data, histopathological and molecular pathology findings, bronchoscopic investigation results, and longitudinal follow-up data

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
individuals undergoing low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) in the radiology department for a clinical indication as part of a lung health check, for example participants in a lung cancer early detection programme; or with a confirmed lung disease or suspected lung disease.
Exclusion criteria:
individuals aged under 18 years; 
absence of informed constent
